messages:
Maya: Quick heads up — Cobalt cohort (beta) needs 3 onboarding touchpoints + a lightweight feedback loop before next Wed. One account showed a billing note that might bump to renewal risk if we don’t get them comfortable. Can we align owners?
Sam: On it. I can own the first two touchpoints (kickoff + pattern review). When do we want to schedule?
Diego: I can take feedback capture and synthesize M4 metrics into a short weekly digest. I already have a template.
Jordan: FYI tagging @Jordan — I'll follow the billing note after lunch and confirm whether it's on the account or invoice side.
Maya: Thanks. Proposed cadence: Kickoff (live 30m), Enablement deep-dive (45m), Feedback sync (15m async + 15m live). Prefer to keep live sessions later in the week.
Sam: Proposed times (PST): Tue 3pm, Thu 11am, Fri 10am. Which works for the cohort?
Diego: Thu 11am + Fri 10am sound good. For the async feedback, I'll share a short form + Slack thread. Form preview: https://forms.redwood.com/cobalt-feedback-alpha
Maya: Diego please use the short form + ask 3 focused questions: 1) blocker, 2) quality surprise, 3) cost/latency tradeoff. Keep it <= 5 questions so they actually fill it. :memo:
Diego: Ack. Draft snippet:```
1) What stopped you from completing the flow?
2) Which output was unexpected or low quality?
3) Any callouts on latency or cost you noticed?
4) Anything we should add to the docs?
```
Sam: Also linking the enablement playbook: https://docs.redwood.com/cs/onboarding/cobalt-playbook — includes checklist and slide deck.
Jordan: Update on the billing flag: looks like an unused seat on their Dedicated plan triggered the finance ping; reached out to the AE for clarification. Will update here by EOD.
Maya: If AE confirms it's on our side, let's prioritize a quick credit or seat swap to avoid renewal churn conversation. We should treat this as a high-touch account until resolved.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invites pending for Sam (3) and Diego (2) — run `/invite cobalt-team` to push invites.
Sam: I'll send invites after Jordan confirms the AE note.
Diego: I'll put the feedback form live tomorrow and post the Slack thread + summary doc in #cs-reads.
Maya: Perfect. One more ask — include one example prompt that caused confusion (we can use it in our docs/eval). Sam, can you capture during enablement?
Sam: Yep — will collect 2 examples and paste them in the feedback doc.
Jordan: Billing update: AE confirmed it's an internal over-provision; AE will propose a seat swap today. Marking this as "watching" not "at-risk" for now. :eyes:
Maya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll stitch the agenda + invite text and drop in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
